text.en: Dog owners consistently commend Laura for her cheerful demeanour and calming presence. Reviewers describe her as an exceptionally patient stylist who takes genuine time to understand each dog's personality, creating an unhurried one-to-one atmosphere.

Clients report that their pets emerge looking polished, tidy, and smelling fresh after their appointments. Owners praise clean scissor work, thorough bath routines, and skilful handling of difficult coat areas such as delicate feet trims and hygiene clips.

Pet parents highlight how well nervous, dramatic, or senior dogs are handled during grooming sessions. Several reviewers note that even pets that typically dislike salon visits remain relaxed and happy under her gentle and reassuring handling techniques.

q.en: Does Lou's Grooming cater to nervous or reactive dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers highlight the groomer's calm approach and patience with anxious, dramatic, or first-time pets.

q.en: What grooming services are offered at the salon?

a.en: The salon offers full haircuts, warm hydrobath washing, blow-drying, nail clipping, puppy introductory sessions, and ultrasonic teeth cleaning.

q.en: Can senior pets be accommodated safely?

a.en: Yes, clients with senior dogs mention that appointments are paced comfortably to ensure elderly pets remain supported throughout.
Bookings can be made online via the HeyGoldie booking platform.
